channel.title: ColaOS / Cola Blog
channel.description: Product notes, engineering updates, and essays from the ColaOS / Cola team.

item.title: Giving an Agent a Self
item.dc:creator: Ethan
item.description: Why memory alone does not make an AI agent feel like someone, and how Cola's self-reference system lets an agent grow through lived experience.

item.title: Stop Asking the Agent to Remember
item.dc:creator: Ethan
item.description: Why agent memory should compete for context budget instead of merely storing more, and how Cola uses salience bookmarks and consolidation to keep the main agent focused.

item.title: Prompt Caching for Agents: Engineering Practices
item.dc:creator: Mack
item.description: Using the Claude API as an example, this post explains how prompt caching works for agents, what it saves, and how to keep cache hit rates high.

item.title: How One Person Manages 20 Repositories: My Agent Harness Engineering Practice
item.dc:creator: 0xFango
item.description: 0xFango explains how Agent Harness turns the deterministic parts of multi-repository agent workflows into explicit engineering protocols.

item.title: Vibe Cola: the design thinking behind the first Mod
item.dc:creator: Xinbao
item.description: The new Cola release introduces the Vibe Cola Mod. This post explains why it is not just coding inside chat, but a real coding workspace built on Mod, Scope, Session, and Runner abstractions.

item.title: Quality judgment in AI projects is shaped by many links in the chain
item.dc:creator: Shuo
item.description: How Cola QA connects pre-review, Eval, CDP, Prism, environments, reports, and release flow so quality signals can support real release decisions.

item.title: Some thoughts on pnpm audit --fix
item.dc:creator: LitoMore
item.description: A look at how pnpm audit --fix behaves in pnpm 11, the difference between override and update modes, and the maintenance cost of minimumReleaseAgeExclude.

item.title: The evolution of the Windows sandbox design in ColaOS
item.dc:creator: Gaoyang
item.description: Gaoyang explains ColaOS's Windows fshook sandbox: from Detours-based file IO hooks to process confinement, policy delivery, logging, and violation feedback in production.

item.title: From All-Hands Builder to AI Native: a veteran programmer's repositioning
item.dc:creator: Zili
item.description: Zili reflects on the shift from ListenHub to ColaOS: from AI-assisted development to making AI produce reliable engineering output in an AI Native team.

item.title: A year of chasing AI: learning to assist AI in programming
item.dc:creator: Kaibin
item.description: Kaibin reflects on a year at MarsWave: moving from AI-assisted coding to engineers organizing context, defining tasks, and assisting AI in programming.
